arguments.text: Liverpool are favoured to beat Chelsea at home, with the model making them slight favourites at 52% compared to the league baseline of 45% for home wins. The standout feature of this fixture is the expectation of goals: the model assigns 74% probability to over 2.5 goals, well above the 52% league baseline, with Liverpool's expected goals of 2.34 substantially outweighing Chelsea's 1.71. Both teams to score is also elevated at 61%, suggesting an attacking contest despite Chelsea's relative underperformance in expected goals.
